meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后,助手能用你自己手机上的 Signal 号码收发消息:通过 signal-cli 设备链接接入,不注册新号码,也没有机器人 API。支持 Markdown 格式、引用回复、私聊打字指示;语音消息只留占位提示,需另装转录。
howto.when: 当你想让助手接入 Signal 时触发,比如在 /setup 流程中,或要新增 Signal 频道。它会安装 signal-cli、复制适配器、扫码链接,并重启服务加载。

say.text: 把这个 Signal 频道装上,用扫码方式链接我的账号
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并给出二维码

say.text: 帮我不做扫码,用独立号码注册方式接入 Signal
say.note: 走 captcha 加短信/语音验证注册新号码

say.text: Signal 消息不回复,帮我查一下日志
say.note: 排查守护进程与成员授权问题

howto.what_en: The assistant sends and receives Signal messages as the number on your own phone, linked as a secondary device via signal-cli — no new number, no bot API. Markdown, quoted replies and DM typing indicators are supported.
howto.when_en: When you want to add Signal to the assistant, e.g. during /setup or when adding a Signal channel. It installs signal-cli, copies the adapter, links by QR scan, then restarts.

say_en.text: Add the Signal channel and link my account by QR code
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and shows a QR code

say_en.text: Set up Signal with a dedicated number instead of linking
say_en.note: Registers a new number via captcha and SMS

say_en.text: Signal messages aren't arriving - check the logs
say_en.note: Looks at daemon and membership issues
